candidates.tagline: Waymo's 6th recall: its AI drove into freeway construction 13 times in 6 months
candidates.story: Waymo issued its sixth safety recall in twelve months on June 18, 2026, pulling 3,871 robotaxis after 13 incidents of its self-driving AI autonomously entering closed freeway construction zones in Phoenix and San Francisco.
candidates.why_funny: A vehicle billed as 'safer than human drivers' has now been recalled six times in a year — most recently for driving into road construction, the one obstacle every human driver knows to steer around.
candidates.alt: White Waymo Jaguar I-PACE autonomous robotaxi on a West Miami street, sensor array visible on the roof, parked near a palm tree in clear daylight

candidates.tagline: FIFA stops World Cup matches for 'hydration' in 66°F rain — so Fox can sell ads
candidates.story: FIFA introduced mandatory three-minute 'hydration breaks' in all 2026 World Cup matches, insisting they're for player welfare — but they stop play even in 19°C/66°F rainy Toronto, air-conditioned Dallas, and indoor Atlanta, while Fox Sports airs full-screen commercials during every pause.
candidates.why_funny: FIFA designed a player-welfare break that triggers in cold, wet, air-conditioned stadiums where the only thing being refreshed is Fox's $200,000-per-slot ad revenue — and every fan in every stadium boos it.
candidates.alt: Scotland players in dark navy jerseys clustered at the touchline taking water bottles during an official hydration break in their 2026 World Cup match against Morocco
